title: Statistics For Agriculture and Biological Sceinces
modules: Concept Of Hypotheis Formulation & Experimental Design
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means only two variables are involved."
Simple in the sense means only two variables are involved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a subgroup of the population selected for study."
A sample is a subgroup of the population selected for study.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the nearness of any measurement to the actual value of the variable being measured."
Accuracy is the nearness of any measurement to the actual value of the variable being measured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a dependent relationship between two or more variables."
Regression is defined as a dependent relationship between two or more variables.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when there are more than 2 qualitative variables where the Simple Correspondence Analysis is not possible and the relationships between the characters are studied."

Multiple Correspondence Analysis is used when there are more than 2 qualitative variables where the Simple Correspondence Analysis is not possible and the relationships between the characters are studied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a percentage expression for __________. a."
The coefficient of variation is a percentage expression for __________. a.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement of what a hypothesis test is set up to establish."
The alternative hypothesis is a statement of what a hypothesis test is set up to establish.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special probability distribution that describes the distribution of probabilities when there are only two possible outcomes for each trial of an experiment."
A binomial distribution is a special probability distribution that describes the distribution of probabilities when there are only two possible outcomes for each trial of an experiment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by just two statistics, the mean and the standard deviation."
The normal distribution is defined by just two statistics, the mean and the standard deviation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a live session that is provided by a facilitator through University approved source (Zoom) for 1 hour."
The synchronous session is a live session that is provided by a facilitator through University approved source (Zoom) for 1 hour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as the regression of Y on X."
The relationship is described as the regression of Y on X.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of techniques that have the aim to classify observations or individuals in clusters."
Cluster analysis is a group of techniques that have the aim to classify observations or individuals in clusters.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a discrete probability distribution that is useful when n is larger and p is small and when the independent variables occur over a period of time."
A Poisson distribution is a discrete probability distribution that is useful when n is larger and p is small and when the independent variables occur over a period of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a tentative prediction about the nature of the relationship between two or more variables."
Hypothesis can be defined as a tentative prediction about the nature of the relationship between two or more variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the variable in regression that cannot be? 3."
A dependent variable (Y) is the variable in regression that cannot be? 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an observable quantity/attribute that varies from one biological entity (member of the population being studied) to another."
Variable is an observable quantity/attribute that varies from one biological entity (member of the population being studied) to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statistical package developed especially for the social sciences but it has wide applicability in the areas of biology and agriculture."
SPSS is a statistical package developed especially for the social sciences but it has wide applicability in the areas of biology and agriculture.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the relationship is a straight line."
Linear means the relationship is a straight line.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as a group of techniques that have the aim to visualize, classify and interpret the data."
Multidimensional analysis may be defined as a group of techniques that have the aim to visualize, classify and interpret the data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when sample size is <30."
One-sample t test is used when sample size is <30.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an additional experimental run or treatment. b."
Control group is an additional experimental run or treatment. b.
fib: ______ is a scatter of related values, such as the assortment of weights in a group of cattle.
distribution
A distribution is a scatter of related values, such as the assortment of weights in a group of cattle.
______ is used when the samples are not drawn from normal distribution.
Wilcoxon signed rank test
Wilcoxon signed rank test is used when the samples are not drawn from normal distribution.

Parameters
Parameters is a descriptive property that describes/characterize a population such as descriptive property is referred to as a parameter (e.g., means).

Simple Correspondence analysis
Simple Correspondence analysis is one of the most known tools for qualitative data.

Experimental design
Experimental design is a field of investigation concerned with the structure and planning of experiments.

statistic
A statistic is an estimator of the population parameter from the sample. v.

design

Population/Universe
Population/Universe is defined as the entire collection of measurements about which the statistician wishes to draw conclusion.

Samples
Samples is a subset of all the measurements in the population of interest.

resulting graphs

Estimation
Estimation is the entire process of using an estimator to produce an estimate of a parameter.

histogram
A histogram is a graph in which classes are marked on the horizontal axis and the frequencies, relative frequencies, or percentages are marked on the vertical axis.
______ can be defined as the chance of an event occurring.
Probability

Analysis of variance (ANOVA)
Analysis of variance

______ is the sign test for single samples.
simplest non-parametric test
The simplest non-parametric test is the sign test for single samples.
______ can be defined as the sum of the observed values of a set divided by the number of observations in the set.
Mean
Mean can be defined as the sum of the observed values of a set divided by the number of observations in the set.
______ is a line graph of class frequency plotted against class mark.
frequency polygon
A frequency polygon is a line graph of class frequency plotted against class mark.

Discriminant analysis
Discriminant analysis is used to verify if the prior classification is confirmed after using the explicative variables.

Statistics
Statistics is used to verify formulated tests and hypotheses.
